source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12.2, printed page 111, with Table 5.5 and Quick Check 5.8 with answers.

blocks.text: Amorphous solids, crystalline solids ke ulat, regular three-dimensional geometrical shakal nahi rakhte. Misalein: glass (sheesha), wood (lakri), amorphous sulphur (plastic sulphur), charcoal, coal, coke waghera.
Properties of amorphous solids (amorphous solids ki properties)

items: Amorphous solids mein kahin kahin chhote hisse ho sakte hain jahan particles orderly hon, magar long range (door tak) regular arrangement nahi hota. In chhote orderly hisson ko crystallites kehte hain.
Glass jaise amorphous solids ek fixed temperature ke bajaye temperature ki ek bari range mein pighalte hain.
Inhen mould kiya (saanche mein dhala) aur blow (phoonk) kar alag alag shaklon mein banaya ja sakta hai.
Amorphous solids ki heat of fusion ki koi definite (fixed) value nahi hoti.

blocks.caption: Table 5.5 Crystalline aur amorphous solids ka comparison
rows: Aam taur par lump (dhela) ya bareek powder ki shakal mein.
Apne melting point par sharply (ek dam) pighalte hain.
Sharp melting point nahi; temperature ki ek range mein pighalte hain.
Anisotropic: properties is baat par depend karti hain ke kis direction mein naapi jayein.
Isotropic: properties har direction mein ek jaisi.

blocks.prompt: a) Solids ki compressibility aur expansion bohat kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Particles pehle hi ek doosre ko chhoo rahe hain, dabane ke liye khali jagah nahi. Attractive forces itni mazboot hain ke garam karne par bhi particles jagah nahi chhorte, sirf thora zyada vibrate karte hain, is liye volume bohat kam barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Crystal ki habit se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh shakal jis mein crystal fixed conditions (shartein) par aam taur par ugta hai, jaise NaCl ka cube. Conditions ya impurity badlein to habit badal sakti hai (10% urea se NaCl needle jaisa).

blocks.prompt: c) Solids translatory motion kyun nahi karte?
blocks.explanation: Mazboot ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces har particle ko us ki jagah par jama deti hain, is liye particle ek jagah se doosri jagah nahi ja sakta; sirf apni jagah ke gird vibrate karta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Zyada tar solids asani se compress kyun nahi hote?
blocks.explanation: Particles close-packed hain aur un ke darmiyan jagah bohat kam hai (gol particles bhi zyada se zyada 74% bharte hain, baqi jagah itni chhoti hai ke koi particle andar nahi ja sakta). Aur dabane ke liye particles ko khud dabana parega, jo possible nahi.

blocks.prompt: Glass ko phoonk kar botal banai ja sakti hai, magar namak (NaCl) ke crystal ko nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Glass amorphous hai: sharp melting point nahi, garam karne par aahista aahista naram ho kar gaarha liquid banta hai jise shakal di ja sakti hai. NaCl crystalline hai: woh apne melting point tak sakht rehta hai aur phir ek dam patla liquid ban jata hai, beech mein koi naram stage nahi.

items: Amorphous solids (glass, wood, plastic sulphur, charcoal, coal, coke): regular shape nahi, sirf chhote crystallites, temperature ki range mein pighalte hain, mould aur blow ho sakte hain, heat of fusion fixed nahi.
Table 5.5: crystalline = khas shakal, sharp melting point, anisotropic, long-range order; amorphous = lump/powder, range mein pighalna, isotropic, long-range order nahi.
